evidence: All ten numeric CSV tables under data/raw and data/processed were read and inventoried at fixed commit; model/experiment plotting script, LICENSE, CITATION.cff, data/readme and primary publication passages screened.
findings: A floating brake caliper, lever and load cell instrument braking torque. The verification table compares 1.18/3.76/6.52 Nm mechanical torque with 1.15/3.65/6.21 Nm electrical torque for the three loads. Load-cell calibration includes four tabulated points including zero.

The 101-row load-step CSV in raw and processed directories is byte-identical (same Git blob). The 121 model/experiment rows yield speed RMSE 7.370329 rpm using recorded speed columns and 7.370267 from the stored error column. The article abstract reports 14.8 rpm. The match for this Git snapshot could not be established. The Git snapshot predates the 2026-05-30 published article; the authors also cite a distinct archive identifier.
limits: The author describes raw/ as acquired OR tabulated. Three torque verification conditions are summary estimates with SD, without unrestricted command, limited command or per-trial torque traces.

Zenodo pairs are linked as published: direct archive API availability was not verified. A Zenodo version relation or complete byte-equivalence with either archive is not established. The result compares only the fixed GitHub table and cited report.
